For example, let's take a look at the following expression: 

$$
2(3+4).
$$

 

We can evaluate this expression using the distributive law:

![](images/4c/4ca32844e45f756ce88e4d8e6d73e8b69099d2c517157b51fed9bb1f02a699ea.png)

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}2(3+4) & = \\ 2\cdot 3+2\cdot 4 & = \\ 6+8 & = \\ 14 & .\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
2(3 + 4) &=  \\

\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}
(3 + 4) \cdot 2 &=  \\

6 + 8 &=  \\
&= 14
\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}

$$
